0: ‘If you want to annoy an opponent thoroughly, and even to harm him,’ said a crafty old knave to me, ‘you reproach him with the very defect or vice you are conscious of in yourself. Be indignant ... and reproach him!
1: ‘To begin with, it will set others thinking you have not that vice.
2: ‘In the second place, your indignation may well be sincere.... You can turn to account the pricks of your own conscience.
3: If you, for instance, are a turncoat, reproach your opponent with having no convictions!
4: ‘If you are yourself slavish at heart, tell him reproachfully that he is slavish ... the slave of civilisation, of Europe, of Socialism!’
5: ‘One might even say, the slave of anti-slavishness,’ I suggested.
6: ‘You might even do that,’ assented the cunning knave.
